name: Bird spawns (various)
accessNote: Chickens and ducks cluster at low-level farms such as Lumbridge, Fred the Farmer's field, and Falador; other counted birds (seagulls, penguins, terrorbirds, vultures) are spread widely. Every spot in the Slayer task/Birds location table (pageid 259880) is single-combat, cannonable and safespottable.
